budget_items.quote: the library is concerned about the effect to their expenditures relative to fy15 budget from the increase in electricity costs.

budget_items.topic: School choice-out students and cost to the Town
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Schools are checking reported choice-out of 87 students; if valid it means a cost increase to the Town, though the figure may be an overstatement.
budget_items.quote: this if valid, means a $100,000 increase in costs to the town.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The school committee decided on an FY16 budget that is a percentage over FY15, to increase further as staffing effects are added.
budget_items.quote: at the 1/7 meeting the school committee decided on an fy16 budget that would be a 6.09% over the fy15 budget.

budget_items.quote: thus the town will put together the fy16 budget without formal input on levels of state aid.
